summary: Iteration 5 (frontend only) tested end-to-end in mobile web preview (390x844) against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All four target flows PASS. (1) Cetak Kartu QR: on /presensi -> Gymnastic A, print-qr-cards-button is rendered for the keuangan account; tapping it kicks off exportPdf -> expo-print Print.printAsync which on web calls window.print exactly once (window.__print_calls=1) with no page error, no red screen, and no app crash. (2) Mark-paid WA receipt: from Tagihan tab -> unpaid invoice dadea8ad-... -> mark-paid-button, after window.confirm auto-accept the invoice flips to Lunas (invoice-status-badge='Lunas') AND exactly one wa.me URL opens: https://wa.me/6281234567801?text=Yth.%20Ibu%20Rina%20dari%20Aisyah%20Putri%2C%0A%0ATerima%20kasih%2C%20pembayaran%20Anda%20sudah%20kami%20terima%20%E2%9C%85%0A%E2%80%A2%20Kelas%3A%20Gymnastic%20%E2%80%93%20paket%2012%20pertemuan%0A%E2%80%A2%20Jumlah%3A%20Rp%20900.000%20(transfer) ... which decoded contains the required 'Terima kasih' AND 'Sisa kredit sekarang: <N> pertemuan' lines (receiptMessage format exactly matches /app/frontend/src/format.ts). (3) Button swap: on the same invoice after payment and on an already-paid invoice f33475a3-... the primary WA button is send-receipt-whatsapp-button (visible & enabled because parent_phone exists), while send-whatsapp-invoice-button and mark-paid-button are both NOT rendered — matches the paid? ternary in /app/frontend/app/invoice/[id].tsx:183-202. Tapping send-receipt-whatsapp-button fires the same receiptMessage wa.me URL (verified via window.open intercept). (4) Report export-pdf-button: /report screen (reached via Beranda 'Laporan Bulanan' link) still renders export-pdf-button; tapping it invokes window.print exactly once with no crash, confirming the refactor to the shared src/pdf.ts helper is non-regressing. No red-screen, no React Native 'Text component' errors. Only the pre-existing cosmetic RN-web warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' persists (3rd-party, carried over from iter 2).
action_items: (Not blocking) Empty-class 'Belum ada siswa' alert path was not UI-tested because all seeded classes have students; code path in /app/frontend/app/class/[id].tsx:82-85 is a simple notify() guard before exportPdf — safe by inspection.
(Not blocking, carried over) RN-web console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' from upstream RN components. No fix needed.

(Nice-to-have) Guru-role print-qr-cards-button visibility was validated by code inspection (/app/frontend/app/class/[id].tsx:117-120 renders the button unconditionally; only edit-class-button is gated on user?.role === 'keuangan'), not re-clicked after keuangan logout in this run because the sticky bottom bar on Report hid the tab-beranda link in Playwright; functionally correct per code — no action required.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pdf.ts cleanly centralises exportPdf (web -> Print.printAsync, native -> printToFileAsync + Sharing.shareAsync) and qrSheetHtml. qrcode.toString(..., {type:'svg', margin:1, width:150}) inlines SVG per card and the esc() helper escapes name/schedule before interpolation — no XSS vector. 31% width + flex-wrap on .grid gives a 3-column print layout with page-break-inside:avoid per card. Good.

/app/frontend/app/invoice/[id].tsx:28-39 pay.onSuccess awaits sendReceipt(inv) only when inv.parent_phone is present; sendReceipt wraps api.student + sendWhatsApp in try/catch and falls back to notify('Lunas', ...) so a network error on student fetch does not break the paid-state redraw. Mutation.onSuccess still calls qc.invalidateQueries() first so UI flips to Lunas before the WA tab opens — matches observed behaviour.

/app/frontend/app/invoice/[id].tsx:181-202 sticky action bar uses testID={paid ? 'send-receipt-whatsapp-button' : 'send-whatsapp-invoice-button'} and only renders mark-paid-button when !paid. The disabled={!inv.parent_phone} guard on the WA button correctly covers the no-phone edge case for both unpaid-invoice and paid-receipt variants.

/app/frontend/src/format.ts receiptMessage reads inv.paid_at (falling back to new Date().toISOString()) so even if the backend response races the payment-write, the WA text always has a Tanggal line. creditsNow defaults to inv.package when wallet is missing — defensive and correct.

/app/frontend/app/report.tsx reportHtml + savePdf (shared helper) correctly removes the previously-duplicated Print.printAsync call site. exporting state wraps the shared helper so the Button loading indicator reflects the real inflight state.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Re-used the pre-existing TEST credentials and the single unpaid invoice dadea8ad-c83d-48d1-855d-6997c9e489b5 (Aisyah Putri, gymnastic, 12-pkg, parent_phone 6281234567801) that was already in Mongo from an earlier iteration — the mark-paid test transitions it to paid; this is irreversible per API spec but acceptable (noted by main agent). No cleanup required; no TEST_* docs added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: window.open and window.print must be intercepted via page.add_init_script BEFORE page.goto, because RN-web Linking.openURL calls window.open synchronously and expo-print Print.printAsync on web calls window.print after writing an iframe. Direct page.goto to /invoice/<id> after login clears auth state (zustand not hydrated from storage on fresh document) and shows 'Not authenticated' — always navigate via tabs/row click. Pre-existing unpaid invoice at dadea8ad-c83d-48d1-855d-6997c9e489b5 has now been MARKED PAID by this iteration; next iteration will need to POST /api/invoices to seed a fresh unpaid one if re-testing the mark-paid path (student d1d9ebd0-... + program gymnastic currently has no unpaid invoice; use program english or a different student). The sticky bottom action bar in invoice detail and report screens overlaps the tab bar at 390x844 — in Playwright use `await page.get_by_text('Laporan Bulanan').first.click(force=True)` from Beranda instead of trying to tap tab-beranda from a deep screen.
